_doc: Gate-checks SCOPE (v22 prep, s131). Binds two sources that must agree but had no test between them:
harness/gate_checks.json rows that read a SPECIFIC zone's surface, and the wall scripts (harness/scripts/*.json)
that stage a start zone (`start.zone`; absent = the world's HOME_ZONE). test/harness/gate_checks_audit_test.rb
enforces: every scoped id exists in gate_checks.json; every zone here exists in data/zones/; every scoped check
has at least one wall script starting in one of its zones; every wall start zone is read by a scoped check OR
is listed under unread_start_zones with a reason (exact both ways - a stale row fails, a new gap fails).
Zone-generic rows (HUD, telegraphs, corpses, zone_identity_reads...) are deliberately NOT scoped.

unread_start_zones.basement_1: BASEMENT 1 is staged by basement_pocket.json but no gate row reads its surface by name (only zone-generic rows judge it). Candidate gate row for the v22 art lane (A4); recorded 2026-09-05.
unread_start_zones.gate_fixture: TEST 1 is a fixture zone: menu_tour.json starts here to stage menu_* surface rows, none of which names the zone - by design, the surfaces belong to every zone with a requires_level way. level_gate.json retired s135 (E1, T0 d6); level_gate_reads is a debt row until its re-author.
